design: A hulking stocky ochre-grey ogre brute with huge belly and shoulders, small bald head with a few dark tufts, broad square nose, two stubby lower tusks, small narrowed dark eyes and a dim-witted nasty grin. A stitched brown leather vest hanging open, rough fur waistwrap, ragged dark trousers, wrist wraps and heavy bare three-toed feet. Holds one chunky knotted wooden club in foreground hand, far fist clenched. Exactly two arms/two legs. Exaggerated cartoon fantasy thug, not a baby, not cuddly, no gore or realistic human flesh. Idle weighty planted stance and slow breathing; hurt recoils angry and startled; attack winds club over shoulder then smashes to RIGHT; dodge crouches and leans back with comical annoyed face. Same size, anatomy and club in all16poses.
